title: Export cotrans / cotrans_with_speed through swisseph-ffi
description: swe_dashboard's Ephemeris seam needs cotrans (coordinate transformation, swe_cotrans counterpart) via the Dart package, but swisseph-ffi has no export for it. The engine functions exist: `pub fn cotrans(xpo: [f64; 3], eps: f64) -> [f64; 3]` at src/math.rs:329 and `cotrans_with_speed(xpo: [f64; 6], eps: f64) -> [f64; 6]` at src/math.rs:341. Pure math, no handle/config needed.

acceptance_criteria.text: swisseph_cotrans and swisseph_cotrans_with_speed exported from swisseph-ffi with tests
wasm artifact rebuilt with the new symbols

implementation_plan:
1. Add `swisseph_cotrans` and `swisseph_cotrans_with_speed` extern "C" exports to swisseph-ffi (natural home: a math section — date.rs holds the other free-fn exports like swisseph_split_deg; follow its out-pointer conventions).
2. Follow existing conventions for array in/out marshalling (see swisseph_split_deg / azalt exports).
3. These are free functions (no SweEphemeris handle) — mirror how swisseph_julday/swisseph_day_of_week are declared.
4. Rebuild the wasm artifact so the new symbols are available to swisseph.rs.dart's web bindings (the Dart binding task in swisseph-rs-dart depends on this).
5. Tests: round-trip against known ecliptic↔equatorial values (eps = mean obliquity at J2000); compare with C swe_cotrans output from the swetest oracle if convenient.
execution_record: FFI exports (swisseph_cotrans, swisseph_cotrans_sp) and tests already existed in swisseph-ffi/src/util.rs and swisseph-ffi/tests/date.rs. Only missing piece was the wasm EXPORTED_FUNCTIONS list in swisseph.rs.dart/wasm/build.sh. Added both symbols and rebuilt the wasm artifact. Committed to swisseph.rs.dart main as d505650.
